tools.name: read_evidence
tools.description: Read the full text of a specific evidence chunk by its id (as returned by search_knowledge). Returns JSON with the chunk's id, text, citation_label, source_display_name, and heading.

tools.name: read_range
tools.description: Read exact cells from the spreadsheet (.xlsx workbook) that a chunk came from, straight from the stored workbook -- use it instead of quoting a search snippet when you need exact values, or all rows/cells of a total. A blank cell is null with blank true -- it is NOT zero. A formula cell with cached_value_missing has no known value.

tools.name: calculate
tools.description: Do arithmetic on spreadsheet cells exactly. Never compute numbers yourself; use this for every sum, average, difference, ratio, percentage change, minimum, maximum or count. Returns JSON with result, result_text, the exact inputs (value, cell, header, units), the expression, units, citation_labels and provenance 'derived'. It refuses inputs with different or ambiguous units, and reports blank, text or missing-value cells as errors instead of treating them as zero.

chunk_id.description: A chunk_id returned by search_knowledge; it selects the workbook.

sheet.description: Sheet name; defaults to the chunk's own sheet.

cell.description: A single cell, e.g. 'B7'. Give cell OR range.

range.description: A range, e.g. 'B2:B7'. Give cell OR range.
